title: XML Media Types
summary: Standardizes the media types text/xml, application/xml, and related types for exchanging XML, plus the +xml suffix convention for naming XML-based types. It tells software how to label and handle XML content. It is on the standards track. It was replaced by RFC 7303.

eli5.summary: Files need labels so computers know how to open them. This gives XML files their official labels and a trick for naming new kinds. A newer document later replaced it.
